_doc: The Muster (out-of-match kit, DECISIONS T-079; docs/gravelight/PROGRESSION.md): before a match each survivor chooses a sidearm and up to `slots` Field Habits. Read by gravelight/player/muster.gd (Muster). Field Habits are NOT perk tonics (perks.json): they are habits a soldier brings from the line, small and permanent for the match, never bought and never lost on a down. Unlock rules ('unlock'): a list of conditions, ANY one unlocks it: {rank: n} (your rank, or any rank once you hold a Commendation), {stat: <profile stats key>, min: n}, {challenges: n} (challenges completed), {dossier: n} (this survivor's dossier level). Effects ('effects'): keys ending _mult multiply, every other number adds; Muster.value(pid, key, default). Hooks: start_scrip (MapRoot, after Economy.reset; not on a campaign arrival), melee_damage_mult (WeaponHolder melee), start_reserve_mult / start_grenades / start_tactical (WeaponHolder._set_start_loadout, also on a co-op respawn), board_scrip (Barricade, on a paid board), bleedout_bonus_s (MapRoot sets Player.bleedout_seconds), regen_delay_mult and sprint_duration_mult (Player), pistol_draw_mult (WeaponHolder swap to a pistol), ammo_price_mult (AmmoBox.quote), revive_time_mult (RevivePoint.hold_time).

pistols.desc: The service .45. Eight rounds, honest weight, and the Armorer's Bench knows it best (its finishes and Loadout Pick are M1911 only).
A picked-up P38. A shade less punch than the .45, quicker to fire again, quicker to reload, steadier from the hip.
A Webley Mk VI .455 revolver. Six heavy rounds that hit nearly twice as hard, a slow break-open reload, no brass on the floor.
A Luger P08 off a dead officer. Flat-shooting and quick to the eye, it carries its punch further than any sidearm. The toggle is slow to reload.

habits.name: Pay Packet
habits.desc: You never spend your last pay. Start every match with +250 Scrip.

habits.name: Whetstone
habits.desc: An hour on the stone every night. Knife and melee damage +25%.

habits.name: Full Haversack
habits.desc: Spare boxes of pistol rounds in every pocket. Your sidearm starts with +50% reserve ammo (also when you respawn).

habits.name: Carpenter's Pencil
habits.desc: A pencil behind the ear and a measure in your head. +5 Scrip on every board that pays.

habits.name: Grenade in the Boot
habits.desc: One more frag tucked where nobody looks. Start with 3 frags instead of 2.

habits.name: Field Dressing
habits.desc: A dressing taped to your helmet. When you go down with a squad around you, you bleed out 15 seconds later.

habits.name: Cool Head
habits.desc: You catch your breath before the others do. Health starts coming back 25% sooner after a hit.

habits.name: Spare Record
habits.desc: A shellac record wrapped in a scarf. Start every match with one Siren Gramophone.

habits.name: Quick Holster
habits.desc: A cut-down holster and a lot of practice. Swapping to your pistol is 35% faster.

habits.name: Long March
habits.desc: Thirty miles a day across Belgium. Your sprint lasts 25% longer.

habits.name: Scrounger
habits.desc: You always know a man who knows a man. Ammo boxes cost you 15% less.

habits.name: Steady Hands
habits.desc: You have done this under fire before. Reviving a teammate takes 20% less time.
